description:
MOTOR Power, premium, passion. Quiet and lightweight, the 90Nm Performance Line PX responds precisely to inputs and supports the rider naturally thanks to its low pedal resistance. The robust drivetrain makes this motor particularly reliable, even on long tours with heavy luggage. DRUMS With the PowerTube 800, you're ready for long rides. Ideal for all your daily commutes, as well as longer weekend excursions. It integrates seamlessly into the frame for a sleek, clean eBike look. DISPLAY The perfect travel companion: The Kiox 500 is extra large, smart, and robust. The ideal display for your next adventure, with navigation and alerts. More connected and personalized With the eBike Flow app, you can connect your smartphone to the BE25 for a better, more connected, safer, and more personalized riding experience. You can customize assistance modes, adjust the drive unit's performance parameters, update your e-bike, access the owner's manual, and use the navigation function. You can also use your smartphone as a digital key to unlock the e-bike, and the removable Kiox 500 display to activate the motor.

BE GREEN TECHNOLOGIES The BE25 BERLINO is a trekking bike with an 800 Wh battery, ideal for those who love long-distance travel with freedom, safety, and style. Equipped with the powerful Bosch Performance Line PX motor, it offers a strong yet smooth push in any situation, with a maximum torque of 90 Nm, perfect for tackling challenging climbs and mixed routes with maximum ease. The aluminum frame combines lightness and strength, ensuring a stable and comfortable ride even on long journeys. The Bosch PowerTube 800 battery is fully integrated into the frame for a clean, modern design, offering extended range for worry-free exploration. The standard equipment includes all the ideal accessories for medium-long range journeys, such as double luggage racks, mudguards and lights. IDEAL FOR BE 25 BERLINO is designed for long excursions on asphalt and dirt roads, but also to accompany you on your daily journeys, both urban and otherwise. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you're looking for a comfortable and versatile e-bike, with a powerful motor and long-range autonomy.
